title: Construction Loans — Completion Requirements and Permanent Financing Terms
content:
A Construction Loans product ends in permanent financing. Per product, this table states what must be in hand before conversion, which line the loan converts into, whether the permanent terms are set at the construction closing, how long a permanent rate quoted at that closing is held, and the number of calendar days after completion within which conversion or payoff must occur.

| Product | Final inspection at 100% complete required before conversion | Certificate of occupancy (or county equivalent) required before conversion | Line the loan converts into | Single close (permanent terms set at the construction closing, no second closing) | Months the permanent rate quoted at closing is held | Calendar days after completion for conversion or payoff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | Yes | Yes | Country Home loan (Rural Home Loans) | No | 0 | 60 |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | Yes | Yes | Country Home loan (Rural Home Loans) | Yes | 12 | 30 |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | Yes | Yes | Country Home loan (Rural Home Loans) | No | 0 | 60 |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | Yes | Yes | Country Home loan (Rural Home Loans) | Yes | 12 | 45 |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | Yes | No | farm real estate loan (Farm Real Estate Loans) | Yes | 9 | 60 |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | Yes | No | farm real estate loan (Farm Real Estate Loans) | Yes | 12 | 60 |

## Definitions

- **Final inspection required** — Boolean; whether a final inspection at 100% complete is required before conversion.
- **Certificate of occupancy required** — Boolean; whether a certificate of occupancy (or county equivalent) is required before conversion.
- **Permanent product** — Line the loan converts into.
- **Single close** — Boolean; whether the permanent loan terms are set at the construction closing (no second closing).
- **Permanent rate lock** — Months the permanent rate quoted at the construction closing is held; 0 = set at conversion.
- **Conversion deadline** — Calendar days after completion within which conversion or payoff must occur.

## Points of reference

- The four home construction products convert into a Country Home loan; the Farm Building and Livestock Facility Construction Loans convert into a farm real estate loan.
- A certificate of occupancy is required before conversion on the four home construction products and is not required on the Farm Building or Livestock Facility Construction Loan; a final inspection at 100% complete is required on all six.
- The Owner-Builder and Two-Close Home Construction Loans show a rate lock of 0 months, which the definition reads as the permanent rate being set at conversion.
- The shortest conversion window is the Single-Close Home Construction Loan's 30 calendar days; the Post-Frame Home Construction Loan allows 45, and the others 60.
